text:
Tanya: Heads-up: Acropolis on-prem activation scheduled tomorrow 02:00 PT. Need final owners + any network/airgap blockers. Owners: @Ravi (net), @Jen (infra), @Kai (platform), @Eli (sre). Please confirm status and callouts by EOD.

Ravi: Net: customer needs firewall rule for outbound traffic. Request: allow 10.45.0.0/16 -> 0.0.0.0/0:443 and DNS pointing to our forwarders (10.8.2.5, 10.8.2.6). No NAT provisioned yet for canary — we can provide if customer approves. Currently blocked on ticket ACR-421.

Jen: Infra: image sync done from our side (rsync + GPG sig). Customer will pull via SFTP (airgapped). Pull scheduled 00:30 PT. Need confirmation they have >=50GB free to unpack images. I will hand off artifact manifest once signed.

Eli: SRE: smoke & health checks ready. Please add these to post-cutover tests:
```
curl -v https://acropolis.local/_health || true
ssh -i /keys/deploy ops@acropolis 'sudo systemctl status redwood-runtime'
```
I'll run the canary after NAT and routing are live. Also need route for 10.45.1.0/24 to reach cache nodes for KV warm.

Kai: Platform: rollout plan = canary 5% for 10m -> 25% for 15m -> full. If KV cache warming fails, auto-fallback to hosted model. Can someone confirm hosted fallback is allowed by customer egress rules?

NetSec: Security checks: confirm IPSec tunnel fingerprints and offline KMS key exchange flow. Do NOT post PSKs here. We need an owner for key rotation (propose Jen). Also need signed AUP from customer before go-live.

ops-bot: Reminder: change window reserved 2026-03-18T02:00:00-PT. Approvals pending: change-ACR-421, security-review-ACR-419.

Tanya: Action items:
- @Ravi: escalate firewall ticket and confirm NAT/egress config by 17:00 PT.
- @Jen: confirm disk + sync success and who will hand the signed artifacts to customer.
- @Kai: ensure hosted fallback route is tested against customer's egress rules.
- @Eli: prepare smoke script and post results here after canary.
Link to checklist: <https://redwood.internal/ops/runbooks/acropolis-activation>

Ravi: :thumbsup: I'll ping the customer infra lead now and add notes to ACR-421.

Jen: Disk confirmed at customer (55GB). I'll hand off artifact list to contact rachel@acropolis and mark it in the runbook.

Eli: I'll post smoke results here after the 5% canary. ETA ~02:25 PT.

Kai: Proposed KV warming timeout = 8m. If KV warm >8m trigger rollback.

NetSec: Agree with 8m. Also record tunnel fingerprints and key rotation owner in the runbook.

Tanya: Perfect — if no blockers by 17:00 PT we'll proceed. Thanks everyone :rocket:

Ravi: :thumbsup:
